unverified_requirements: Reference-view shape, color, embroidery and fur fidelity require actual multi-angle image review.
Native local rotation hard stops and sampled rigid editing poses are checked; collision-free attachment travel and skin deformation remain unverified. Standard GLB stores limit metadata only.
Native fiber splines do not by themselves prove appropriate strand density, root placement or realistic fur.
Source non-manifold edges and intentional open partitions are reported; printability and watertightness are not claimed.
Names do not prove independent sculptural detail for brows, nose, eyelids, side ornaments or wave-trim bases.
GLB container and bounds checks do not establish viewport/render appearance parity.

draco_verification.quantization_bits_scope: Export log configuration is cross-checked; decoded errors are measured. Bit counts are not independently extracted from the compressed bitstream.

specific_native_duplicate_member_alterna.scope: These exact already approved duplicate triangle groups retained a different native member during the two exports. Full triangle position, every UV layer, normals and cyclic winding are proved against actual native source corners. No arbitrary UV or normal tolerance is allowed.

limitations: Position/UV/normal measurements compare unordered vertex attribute sets and compatible seam candidates, not exact face-corner correspondence or topology equivalence.
Draco is lossy for position, UV and normal attributes. Embedded raster texture bytes and material definitions are compared exactly.
A Draco-capable viewer/loader is required. Native curve editing and Blender hard-stop constraints are not available in standard glTF.
Sampled mesh fiber proxies match the verified uncompressed GLB, not the full 980957 native strand set.

normal_quantization_gate.derivation: L1 projection has norm >=1/sqrt(3). Rounded integer x/y plus remaining-sum z and the one-unit boundary correction give projected component-error bounds (.5,1.5,1)/center. The angular bound is asin(sqrt(10.5)/center), plus 64 float32 epsilon radians for arithmetic slack. This is a conservative analytic bound inferred from the referenced encoding implementation, not an independently recovered bitstream parameter.
normal_quantization_gate.comparison_scope: Nearest compatible source NORMAL in the position/UV seam-candidate set; exact per-face-corner correspondence is not established.
